settings.name: USE_BUNKERNET
settings.description: **Enable BunkerNet:** Set to `yes` to enable the BunkerNet threat intelligence sharing.

settings.name: BUNKERNET_FILTER_HEADERS
settings.description: **Filter Reported Headers:** Set to `yes` to send only a short allowlist of request headers and blank the values ModSecurity matched in headers and cookies. When `no`, a report carries every request header except `Cookie`, `Authorization` and `Proxy-Authorization`, and the matched values except those found in them and in cookies.

settings.name: BUNKERNET_SERVER
settings.description: **BunkerNet Server:** The address of the BunkerNet API server for sharing threat intelligence.
